title: Gridigrator:A Very Fast Volume Rendererfor 3D Scalar Fields Defined on Curvilinear Grids
abstract: Gridigrator:A Very Fast Volume Rendererfor 3D Scalar Fields Defined on Curvilinear Grids. A, Globus, Technical Report // Gridigrator is a software module which renders scalar volumes on curvilinear grids by casting rays along grid lines
